groups.label: Statements and main theorems
groups.gloss: The statements of the Riemann Hypothesis and its Dirichlet generalization, and the five final theorems.

groups.label: Adeles of number fields
groups.gloss: Basic facts about adeles, the ring built from all completions of a number field: topology, measures, characters and approximation.

groups.label: Cartan map and Higman's criterion
groups.gloss: Projective modules for finite groups in characteristic p, and Higman's test for when a module is projective.

groups.label: Cusp forms and algebraic forms
groups.gloss: Automorphic forms on unitary groups: rapid decay of cusp forms, finite dimension at fixed level, Poincaré series and algebraic modular forms.

groups.label: Abstract Hecke operators
groups.gloss: Hecke operators for a group and subgroup pair, defined as sums over double cosets, and their composition as convolution.

groups.label: Hasse principle for hermitian forms
groups.gloss: Landherr's Hasse principle, which classifies hermitian forms over a number field by their local forms, and weak approximation for unitary groups.

groups.label: Poincaré series on Bessel subgroups
groups.gloss: Poincaré series built along a Bessel subgroup of a unitary group, their convergence, and unfolding their inner products with automorphic forms.

groups.label: Integration on quotient spaces
groups.gloss: How to integrate over a quotient of a group by a subgroup, including Weil's formula and unfolding sums into integrals.

groups.label: Reduction theory for unitary groups
groups.gloss: Reduction theory: the automorphic quotient of a unitary group has finite volume, with compactness criteria and Minkowski-type lattice bounds.

groups.label: Transference and hermitian lattice masses
groups.gloss: Estimates for unimodular hermitian lattices: short bases from the dual lattice, finite class number and positivity of masses.

groups.label: Adelic unitary groups and levels
groups.gloss: Definitions of unitary groups over the adeles, hermitian spaces, compact open level subgroups and their Haar measures.

groups.label: Witt extension and unimodular lattices
groups.gloss: Witt's theorem that isometries between subspaces extend to the whole hermitian space, over fields and over integral adeles.

groups.label: Theta series of Dirichlet characters
groups.gloss: The theta series of a Dirichlet character, its symmetry, and its Mellin transform, which equals a Gamma factor times the L-function.

groups.label: Landau's lemma for Dirichlet integrals
groups.gloss: Landau's lemma: a one-sided bound on a function rules out poles of its Laplace transform right of the bound's exponent.

groups.label: Pólya–Vinogradov inequality
groups.gloss: An explicit bound for sums of a non-principal Dirichlet character over an initial interval, and the size of Gauss sums.

groups.label: Primes in arithmetic progressions
groups.gloss: Finds one prime congruent to 1 modulo a given power and of controlled size, using a small zero-free region.

groups.label: Zero density for quadratic twists
groups.gloss: Finds a prime whose quadratic twist L-functions have no zeros in a given region, using mean values of real character sums.

groups.label: Formal groups of CM curves
groups.gloss: Elliptic curves with complex multiplication: height of the formal group, the Chowla–Selberg formula and a soft form of the main theorem.

groups.label: Imaginary quadratic class numbers
groups.gloss: The class number of an imaginary quadratic field with prime discriminant is odd; also how its zeta function factors.

groups.label: Kronecker's first limit formula
groups.gloss: Kronecker's first limit formula for a lattice in the complex plane, proved as a one-sided real limit.

groups.label: Local heights of CM theta
groups.gloss: Integrality of theta functions on CM elliptic curves and their torsion translates, using local heights and Tate's trick.

groups.label: Main theorem of complex multiplication
groups.gloss: Galois conjugates of an elliptic curve with complex multiplication, of its isogenies and of its theta function.

groups.label: Galois action on CM theta
groups.gloss: Galois conjugation acts on theta functions of a CM curve through a semilinear map on the finite Weil representation.

groups.label: Weierstrass sigma and theta functions
groups.gloss: Elliptic functions of a lattice: Weierstrass functions, sigma and theta functions, their addition formulas, and how they parametrise the cubic curve.

groups.label: Chebotarev density theorem
groups.gloss: Existence form of Chebotarev's theorem: Frobenius elements at degree-one primes are dense in the Galois group.

groups.label: Galois cohomology in low degree
groups.gloss: Cohomology of Galois groups in degrees up to 2: cocycles, cup products, Shapiro's lemma, Hilbert 90 and Kummer theory.

groups.label: Global class field theory
groups.gloss: Global class field theory: Artin reciprocity, the existence theorem, norm theorems and the Albert–Brauer–Hasse–Noether theorem.

groups.label: Greenberg–Wiles formula and Selmer groups
groups.gloss: Bounds on the size of Selmer groups of Galois cocycles with local conditions, via the Greenberg–Wiles formula and S-units.

groups.label: Grunwald–Wang theorem
groups.gloss: Grunwald's theorem: a global character of prime order exists with prescribed local behaviour at finitely many places.

groups.label: Algebraic Hecke characters
groups.gloss: Hecke characters of CM fields and of the unitary group U(1): definitions, levels, local components and existence of a splitting character.

groups.label: Hecke L-functions
groups.gloss: L-functions of Hecke characters: Euler products, analytic continuation to s = 1 and non-vanishing there.

groups.label: Local class field theory
groups.gloss: Local class field theory: the Artin map of a local field, its behaviour on norms, units and inertia, and the tame symbol.

groups.label: Local Tate duality
groups.gloss: Local Tate duality for Galois cocycles in degree 1, as an upper bound, and the invariant map of the Brauer group.

groups.label: Hilbert ramification theory
groups.gloss: Places of infinite Galois extensions: decomposition and inertia groups, Frobenius elements, cyclotomic characters and local fields.

groups.label: Cup products and Leray–Hirsch
groups.gloss: Cup product with a degree-two class, cohomology with supports, and the Leray–Hirsch theorem, for mod-ℓ cohomology defined as Ext groups.

groups.label: Étale cohomology via v-descent
groups.gloss: Étale cohomology with torsion coefficients, built as Ext groups of presheaves, with descent along v-covers, excision and limits.

groups.label: Hodge cohomology and diagonal class
groups.gloss: Hodge cohomology of varieties as Ext groups: the class of the diagonal, point classes, Künneth surjectivity and a fixed-point formula.

groups.label: Künneth formula in étale cohomology
groups.gloss: Künneth formula for mod-ℓ étale cohomology over a field, stated in Leray–Hirsch form over the special fibre.

groups.label: Hodge–Tate images of point classes
groups.gloss: Classes of points on a projective variety remain non-zero and independent after the Hodge–Tate map to p-adic étale cohomology.

groups.label: Cohomology of the projective line
groups.gloss: Cohomology of the projective line: the Kummer sequence, the first Chern class of O(1), and the projective line formula.

groups.label: Proper base change theorem
groups.gloss: Proper base change for étale cohomology, and invariance of cohomology under extension of algebraically closed fields.

groups.label: Smooth base change theorem
groups.gloss: Smooth base change: for smooth schemes over a valuation ring, restriction to the generic fibre is bijective on étale cohomology.

groups.label: Woods Hole fixed-point formula
groups.gloss: Part of the holomorphic Lefschetz fixed-point formula: the points where two maps agree are finitely many, each with a local term.

groups.label: Kolyvagin–Rubin Euler system bound
groups.gloss: Bounds the odd part of a twisted cohomology group of an abelian field, using Kolyvagin's derivative classes built from Gauss sums.

groups.label: Tate–Shafarevich groups of CM fields
groups.gloss: An explicit bound, in terms of the class number, for the odd part of a twisted Tate–Shafarevich group of a CM field.

groups.label: Stickelberger's theorem on Gauss sums
groups.gloss: Prime factorisation of Gauss sums (Stickelberger) and the Davenport–Hasse product relation, up to roots of unity.

groups.label: Voronoi congruence and Stickelberger elements
groups.gloss: Voronoi's congruence for twisted power sums, giving one bounded integer divisible by the Stickelberger elements for all primes and characters.

groups.label: Real unitary Bessel subgroups
groups.gloss: Coordinates and Haar measures on unipotent and Bessel subgroups of real unitary groups, and invariance of Bessel function norms.

groups.label: Bruhat cells and isotropic flags
groups.gloss: Isotropic flags in a unitary group: their stabilisers, Heisenberg radicals, the big Bruhat cell and Haar measure in these coordinates.

groups.label: Discrete series characters
groups.gloss: Characters of discrete series representations on the compact torus via orbital integrals, with Weyl's character and dimension formulas.

groups.label: Schur orthogonality for discrete series
groups.gloss: Matrix coefficients of integrable discrete series representations: Schur orthogonality and their use as kernels producing cusp forms.

groups.label: Flensted-Jensen discrete series coefficients
groups.gloss: An explicit matrix coefficient of the lowest K-type of a discrete series of U(p,q), with its Casimir eigenvalue, smoothness and decay.

groups.label: Haar measure on unitary groups
groups.gloss: Haar measure on unitary groups U(p,q) in Cayley coordinates, the total volume of U(n), and growth of volumes of balls.

groups.label: Holomorphic discrete series
groups.gloss: Holomorphic discrete series: matrix coefficients of highest weight vectors extend holomorphically and reproduce holomorphic functions.

groups.label: Lowest K-type and Casimir rigidity
groups.gloss: The lowest K-type and the Casimir eigenvalue determine a discrete series matrix coefficient, via analytic vectors of (g,K)-modules.

groups.label: Archimedean theta correspondence
groups.gloss: The local theta correspondence for real unitary dual pairs, matching discrete series through joint harmonic polynomials in Fock space.

groups.label: Branching from GL(n+1) to GL(n)
groups.gloss: Restricting a representation of GL(n+1) to GL(n): each interlacing piece occurs once, given by an explicit integer matrix.

groups.label: Duals of Weyl modules
groups.gloss: The dual of a Weyl module of GL_n described by Jacobi's complementary minors, and the Cartan component of tensor products.

groups.label: Schur modules and Weyl lattices
groups.gloss: Polynomial representations of GL_n over any ring: bases by products of minors, invariant forms, characters and Schur matrices.

groups.label: Cyclic unitary base change
groups.gloss: Base change of automorphic forms on definite unitary groups along cyclic extensions of prime degree, by comparing twisted traces.

groups.label: Frobenius polynomials determine Galois representations
groups.gloss: Polynomials that kill most Frobenius elements, together with spread-out Hodge–Tate weights, fix the rank and characteristic polynomials of a Galois representation.

groups.label: Theta lift to larger rank
groups.gloss: A non-zero theta lift from U(n) to a larger unitary group, used to reduce Galois representations of even rank to odd rank.

groups.label: Hilbert 90 for GL_n
groups.gloss: Hilbert's Theorem 90 for matrices under a cyclic group action at congruence level, with surjectivity of norms on units.

groups.label: Hodge–Tate cocharacter and monodromy
groups.gloss: Sen's theorem: the Hodge–Tate cocharacter of a p-adic Galois representation lies in the Zariski closure of its image.

groups.label: Local-global compatibility at tame level
groups.gloss: Galois representations of automorphic forms match the local representation at tamely ramified places, including inertia and Frobenius action.

groups.label: Galois representations of unitary forms
objects: Galois representations attached to automorphic forms
groups.gloss: Constructs Galois representations attached to Hecke eigenforms on definite unitary groups, matching Hecke polynomials at unramified places.

groups.label: Pseudocharacters and Brauer–Nesbitt
groups.gloss: A semisimple representation is determined by its trace function: pseudocharacters, the Brauer–Nesbitt theorem and Clifford theory.

groups.label: Weight congruences of algebraic forms
groups.gloss: An algebraic modular form is an ℓ-adic limit of forms with very different weights and a prescribed type at the level.

groups.label: Adic completion and commutative algebra
groups.gloss: General commutative algebra lemmas: adic completion, Hensel's lemma, lengths and Fitting ideals over valuation rings, and exact sequences.

groups.label: Fourier inversion and holomorphic integrals
groups.gloss: Assorted analysis lemmas: Fourier inversion on compact quotients, holomorphic parameter integrals, Sobolev bounds and Schur polynomial identities.

groups.label: Schur polynomials and character means
groups.gloss: Identities for Schur polynomials, and averages, inner products and characters of functions on finite groups.

groups.label: Schemes as functors of points
groups.gloss: Basic scheme theory in the functor-of-points style: projective space, line bundles, descent, étale charts, properness and smoothness.

groups.label: Group representations and characters
groups.gloss: Group theory lemmas: characters of finite groups, central projections in group algebras, smooth representations and averaging over compact subgroups.

groups.label: Matrix and linear algebra lemmas
groups.gloss: Matrix lemmas used throughout: block matrices, Smith normal form, minors and determinants, Gaussian integrals, plus global Lean settings.

groups.label: Haar measure and quotient integrals
groups.gloss: Haar measure facts: push-forwards, the modulus of GL_n, integrals over subgroups and quotients, and Leray measures on quadrics.

groups.label: Number field basics
groups.gloss: Number field facts: imaginary quadratic fields, complex embeddings, class number bounds, adelic fundamental domains and ℓ-adic valuations.

groups.label: Schwartz–Bruhat functions on local fields
groups.gloss: Definitions of Schwartz–Bruhat functions on products of local fields, and of tame and additive characters.

groups.label: Green's characters of GL_n(F_q)
groups.gloss: Characters of the finite group GL_n(F_q): Green's cuspidal characters, parabolic induction and their degrees.

groups.label: Iwahori–Hecke algebras of GL_n
groups.gloss: Representations of p-adic GL_n with vectors fixed by a pro-p Iwahori subgroup: U-operators, exponents and spherical vectors.

groups.label: Shintani descent for GL_n(F_q)
groups.gloss: Shintani descent: characters of GL_n over a prime-degree extension of a finite field matched with characters over the base field.

groups.label: Unitary unramified representations of GL_n
groups.gloss: Satake parameters of unitary unramified representations of p-adic GL_n come in strings, as in Tadić's classification.

groups.label: Taylor–Wiles auxiliary primes
groups.gloss: Spaces of integral automorphic forms are nearly free over the finite groups attached to Taylor–Wiles auxiliary primes.

groups.label: Comparing unitary trace formulas
groups.gloss: Hecke traces agree on unitary groups that differ only at real places, by comparing simple trace formulas.

groups.label: Derived completeness and tilting
groups.gloss: Derived completeness of modules for a principal ideal: Nakayama's lemma, finiteness and completed base change, plus tilting of products.

groups.label: Crystalline comparison theorem
groups.gloss: The p-adic étale cohomology of a variety with good reduction is crystalline, proved on charts étale over tori.

groups.label: Congruence relation for crystalline Frobenius
groups.gloss: A relation among Frobenius-twisted maps on the special fibre carries over to crystalline Frobenius operators on p-adic cohomology.

groups.label: v-descent and almost acyclicity
groups.gloss: The tilted structure sheaf is almost acyclic in the v-topology, and cohomology classes descend along v-covers of perfect rings.

groups.label: Integration over products of P¹
groups.gloss: Compares two cohomology theories using integration along the projective line and a diagonal class on products of projective lines.

groups.label: Hodge–Tate comparison map
groups.gloss: A map from Hodge cohomology to p-adic étale cohomology landing in vectors of a given Hodge–Tate weight.

groups.label: Primitive comparison theorem
groups.gloss: The primitive comparison theorem: mod p étale cohomology of smooth proper varieties is finite, and lifts to period-ring coefficients.

groups.label: Faltings' toric towers
groups.gloss: Cohomology of Faltings' toric towers, built by adjoining p-power roots of coordinates, computed one variable at a time.

groups.label: Bloch–Kato local conditions
groups.gloss: The rank of the Bloch–Kato finite local condition for a crystalline Galois representation, and the size of its annihilator.

groups.label: Potentially crystalline characters
groups.gloss: Galois characters with finite image on inertia are potentially crystalline of weight 0.

groups.label: Dwork's trick for crystalline comparison
groups.gloss: An integral crystalline comparison over A_max with one denominator that depends only on the field and the weight range.

groups.label: Potentially crystalline representations
groups.gloss: Definitions and basic rules for crystalline and potentially crystalline Galois representations, Hodge–Tate jumps and the Weil–Deligne Frobenius.

groups.label: Galois lattices and pairings
groups.gloss: Definitions of Galois-stable lattices in potentially crystalline representations and of integral pairings between them used for cup products.

groups.label: Limits of crystalline representations
groups.gloss: Uniform limits of crystalline representations with bounded Hodge–Tate weights stay crystalline with the same weights.

groups.label: Fontaine's period rings
groups.gloss: Fontaine's p-adic period rings A_inf, B_max and B_dR, the map θ, and the fundamental exact sequence.

groups.label: Ax–Sen–Tate theorem
groups.gloss: Elements of C_p fixed by a Galois subgroup are limits of fixed algebraic numbers, and Tate twists of C_p have no invariants.

groups.label: Galois action on Kisin modules
groups.gloss: Galois action on Kisin lattices is trivial modulo the variable, and Hodge–Tate weights can be read off the module.

groups.label: Kisin lattices of crystalline representations
groups.gloss: Builds the Kisin lattice of a crystalline representation from its period matrix, as a module of finite height inside A_inf.

groups.label: Abelian schemes and isogenies
groups.gloss: Basic theory of abelian schemes: isogenies are finite flat, pull-back of line bundles by multiplication maps, and torsion.

groups.label: Theta group of complex tori
groups.gloss: Theta functions on complex tori: convergence, Frobenius's dimension formula and irreducibility of the Heisenberg theta group.

groups.label: Eichler–Shimura congruence relation
groups.gloss: The geometric step of the Eichler–Shimura congruence relation, which links Hecke operators and Frobenius on unitary Shimura varieties.

groups.label: Deformations of PEL abelian varieties
groups.gloss: First-order deformations of the abelian varieties parametrised by a unitary Shimura variety have at most n−1 parameters.

groups.label: Hecke eigenquotients of cohomology
groups.gloss: Cuts the Galois representation of a Hecke eigensystem out of cohomology as the largest quotient where Hecke operators act by that eigensystem.

groups.label: Extending maps of abelian schemes
groups.gloss: Isogenies and line bundles of abelian schemes over a complex valuation ring extend from the generic fibre.

groups.label: Good reduction of PEL varieties
groups.gloss: Abelian varieties in a unitary PEL family have good reduction, shown analytically through sup norms of theta functions.

groups.label: Hecke correspondences on towers
groups.gloss: The Hecke algebra of a group pair acting by correspondences on cohomology of a tower of covers; existence of wild types.

groups.label: Integral Kuga–Sato models
groups.gloss: Builds integral models of Kuga–Sato varieties over unitary Shimura varieties GU(1,n−1), with level covers and Hecke correspondences.

groups.label: Theta groups of line bundles
groups.gloss: The theta group of an ample line bundle on an abelian variety, its group K(L), and symmetric theta structures.

groups.label: Moduli via theta constants
groups.gloss: Moduli of abelian varieties built from values of theta functions, with a universal family over a projective base.

groups.label: Projective normality via theta relations
groups.gloss: Sections of powers of a line bundle on an abelian variety are generated in low degree, also after good reduction.

groups.label: Trace formula on definite groups
groups.gloss: Traces of Hecke operators on algebraic modular forms of definite unitary groups, written as sums over conjugacy classes.

groups.label: Transfer between unitary inner forms
groups.gloss: Hecke eigensystems of forms on a definite unitary group also occur on the Shimura variety of signature (1, n−1).

groups.label: Complex uniformisation of PEL varieties
groups.gloss: Complex abelian varieties with unitary PEL structure are quotients of complex space by lattices, described by the Appell–Humbert theorem.

groups.label: Siegel–Weil formula
groups.gloss: The Siegel–Weil formula in its convergent range: the average of a theta function over a unitary group equals an Eisenstein series.

groups.label: Mass formula for hermitian lattices
groups.gloss: The ratio of masses of unimodular hermitian lattices in consecutive ranks, with an explicit error.

groups.label: Siegel's representation formula
groups.gloss: Siegel's mean value formula for the number of ways to write a number as a sum of norms from a CM field.

groups.label: Rallis inner product formula
groups.gloss: The Rallis inner product formula, by doubling: the norm of a theta lift is computed as an integral of matrix coefficients.

groups.label: Singular automorphic forms
groups.gloss: An automorphic form whose Fourier coefficients vanish at unimodular indices vanishes, with Witt's theorem and the Iwasawa decomposition.

groups.label: Strong approximation for unitary groups
groups.gloss: An automorphic function invariant under a split place, a compact subgroup and a torus is constant, by strong approximation.

groups.label: Constant terms of theta lifts
groups.gloss: The constant term of a theta lift along an isotropic line equals a smaller theta lift times an explicit L-value factor.

groups.label: Definite unitary theta lifts
groups.gloss: Theta lifts between definite unitary groups written as finite class sums on algebraic modular forms, with seesaw identities for periods.

groups.label: Adelic Weil representation
groups.gloss: Constructs the Weil representation of an adelic unitary group from the Heisenberg group, and the invariant theta functional.

groups.label: Theta kernels of dual pairs
groups.gloss: Theta kernels for unitary dual pairs: functoriality, growth, rapid decay and convergence of theta lifts and their adjoint descents.

groups.label: Bargmann–Fock model
groups.gloss: The oscillator representation of U(p,q) realised on a Fock space of holomorphic functions, with its cocycle and reproducing formulas.

groups.label: Gauss sums on matrix rings
groups.gloss: Gauss sums of a character of the determinant over matrix rings: when they vanish, and their absolute value.

groups.label: Global discrete series theta lifts
groups.gloss: Global theta lifts with joint harmonic data, which carry automorphic forms of one discrete series type to the matching type.

groups.label: Schrödinger and mixed models
groups.gloss: Other realisations of the Weil representation, the Schrödinger and mixed models, and how parabolic subgroups act in them.

groups.label: Bessel and Fourier–Jacobi periods
groups.gloss: How Bessel and Fourier–Jacobi period integrals change under a theta lift, by one unfolding step.

groups.label: Spherical Hecke algebra of GL_n
groups.gloss: Spherical Hecke operators of GL_n at split places commute, and theta lifts carry Hecke polynomials across by Eichler's commutation relation.

groups.label: Main inequality and GRH
groups.gloss: Combines the three main theorems into a bound on weighted prime counts, then deduces GRH and zeros on the critical line.

groups.label: Divisibility of theta lift chains
groups.gloss: Algebraic modular forms on a definite unitary group, and bounds on how divisible a chain of theta lifts is at each prime.

groups.label: Index and class number bounds
groups.gloss: Bookkeeping lemmas for indices of submodules, and a crude bound for the class number of a hermitian genus.

groups.label: Theta jets on CM curves
groups.gloss: p-adic divisibility of Taylor coefficients of theta functions on a CM elliptic curve, along special lattice bases.

groups.label: Proof parameters and number fields
groups.gloss: Sets up the proof's parameters and fields, the CM field E over an imaginary quadratic field, and shows suitable choices exist.

groups.label: Explicit discrete series asymptotics
groups.gloss: Explicit estimates for discrete series matrix coefficients near the identity, giving large Bessel functions and Poincaré series periods.

groups.label: Theorems A–C and zero-free region
groups.gloss: The three main theorems about theta lifts, and the step from a one-sided prime count bound to a zero-free half-plane.

groups.label: Exchange identities for theta integrals
groups.gloss: Identities that swap theta integrals of complementary rank, used to compute norms and injectivity of chains of theta lifts.

groups.label: Second moments of Poincaré series
groups.gloss: Shows translates of Poincaré series fill the space of automorphic forms, by bounding second moments with Bessel kernels and a sieve.

groups.label: Auxiliary dual pair lift
groups.gloss: An auxiliary dual pair whose theta lift is a class sum, with its test datum and transformation law.

groups.label: Uniqueness of cuspidal labels
groups.gloss: A Hecke eigensystem has at most one primitive cuspidal label at a chosen place, given an injective lift to a definite group.

groups.label: Heights of ℓ-adic families
groups.gloss: Heights for numbers indexed by ℓ-adic embeddings, the product formula, and a height bound for one Gram determinant.

groups.label: Cup products of crystalline cocycles
groups.gloss: Bounds on cokernels of Kisin modules that make cup products of crystalline cocycles vanish, with length bounds for crystalline classes.

groups.label: Deformed traces at auxiliary primes
groups.gloss: A first-order deformation of the trace at one auxiliary prime, used to clear the denominator of a projection to theta lifts.

groups.label: Bessel integrals at real places
groups.gloss: Estimates at the real place: cut-off Bessel functions, their energy and band limits, and integrals over the open Bruhat cell of U(p,q).

groups.label: Twisted theta forms and heights
groups.gloss: Theta forms on indefinite unitary groups twisted by characters: they lie on one line, and the heights of their volumes are bounded.

groups.label: Seesaw identity for theta chains
groups.gloss: A seesaw identity for a chain of theta lifts, with periods unfolded into finite sums with controlled denominators.

groups.label: Selmer groups of twisted lifts
groups.gloss: One anticyclotomic twist makes the Selmer groups of Galois representations of theta lifts small, by Ribet's method and Taylor–Wiles primes.

groups.label: Vanishing of theta descents
groups.gloss: Theta descents along the theta tower vanish when a Hecke root is too small, so non-lifts have zero theta periods.

groups.label: Trace transfer of good forms
groups.gloss: Good forms on different unitary groups have equal Hecke traces, and a Hecke eigensystem meets at most one cuspidal type.

groups.label: Frobenius-twisted Hecke operators
groups.gloss: A Frobenius-twisted Hecke operator has small elementary divisors, shown by counting flags and lattice points in a cone.

groups.label: Decay of Fock coefficients
groups.gloss: An explicit decay bound for Heisenberg matrix coefficients of homogeneous vectors in Fock space, uniform in the degree.
